sentences.text: Guddu vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 July, 2023

Author: Kuldeep Mathur
Bench: Kuldeep Mathur
 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At
 Jodhpur
 S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 8380/2023
Guddu S/o Shri Shankar, Aged About 21 Years, R/o Nathpura
Jambakhal Bariya Police Station Aambapura District Banswara
(Presently Lodged In District Jail, Pratapgarh)
 ----Petitioner
 Versus
State of Rajasthan, through P.P.
 ----Respondent
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ramesh Purohit
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, P.P.
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldeep Mathur
Order 20/07/2023 This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the
petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.39/2023 registered at Police Station
Deogarh, District Pratapgarh for the offences under Sections 366, 376(1), 376(2)
(n), 342 and 109 Ipc.

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan At
 Jodhpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner who is aged about 21 years old was in consensual relationship with the prosecutrix who is aged about 19 years old.
Learned counsel submitted that the prosecutrix voluntarily eloped with the present petitioner on 04.01.2023.

Learned counsel further submitted that the prosecutrix was in the company of the present petitioner while she travelled with him to various places (2 of 3) [CRLMB-8380/2023] like Ujjain using public transportation.
Learned counsel submitted that the prosecutrix, thus had ample opportunities to disclose factum of she being abducted or subjected to sexual assault by the petitioner.

Lastly, learned counsel drew attention of the Court towards the various documents annexed by the Investigating Agency with the charge-sheet submitted before the competent criminal court on 06.05.2023 to show that as a matter of fact, the prosecutrix solemnized marriage with the present petitioner as per Hindu rites and rituals in a temple, however, on their relations turning strained,
Guddu vs State Of Rajasthan on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61100496/
1
the petitioner has been roped in a false criminal case.

It was submitted that challan in the case has already been filed; the petitioner is in judicial custody since 26.03.2023 and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, the petitioner deserves to be enlarged on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner - Guddu S/o Shri Shankar arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.39/2023 registered at Police Station Deogarh, District Pratapgarh shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of (3 of 3)
[CRLMB-8380/2023] Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 192-Ravi Kh/-
